main.summary: Persists publication journals through the PostgreSQL transfer-state store and tenant-scoped transfer storage.

field.name: state
field.summary: Metadata store used to load and persist journal state.

field.name: dataConfigs
field.summary: Client used to resolve configured tenant storage for publication catalogs.

field.name: storageFactory
field.summary: Factory used to persist and restore final publication objects in tenant-scoped storage.

constructor.name: PostgresPublicationJournalStore
constructor.summary: Initializes a PostgreSQL-backed publication journal store.
constructor.param: Client used to resolve configured tenant storage.
Tenant storage factory for final publication objects.

method.name: EnsureOperation
method.summary: Ensures that the requested operation owns the loaded journal.
method.param: Operation identifier that must own the journal.

method.name: LoadForInstanceAsync
method.summary: Loads journal states belonging to the exact catalog, item, and item instance token.
method.returns: Matching persisted journal states without loading tenant payloads.

method.name: DeleteForInstanceAsync
method.summary: Deletes all journals for the exact catalog, item, and item instance token.
method.returns: True when one or more journals were deleted.

method.name: SaveStateAsync
method.summary: Stores the journal payload and its sanitized metadata state.
method.param: Authorized catalog that must own the journal.

method.name: ToState
method.summary: Converts a domain journal into the PostgreSQL persistence state.
method.param: Persisted final-object reference, if one exists.
method.returns: Persistence state containing sanitized journal JSON and durable Blob metadata.

method.name: ToJournalAsync
method.summary: Reconstructs a domain journal from PostgreSQL state, validates its item instance token, and restores its optional final-object payload from token-scoped tenant storage.

method.name: SaveFinalObjectAsync
method.summary: Stores a journal's final publication object under the journal's item-instance and session staging path in catalog tenant-scoped storage.
method.param: Journal containing the catalog, session, item, and operation identifiers.
Final publication object payload to persist.
Cancellation token for the storage operation.
method.returns: Reference to the persisted object, or null when the catalog silo cannot be resolved.

method.name: ToReference
method.summary: Converts a tenant storage blob reference into the journal store's transfer blob reference.
method.returns: Equivalent transfer blob reference, or null when the source reference is null.
